summary: Added lib/backlog.sh (harness backlog [list] | set | import, writes under flock on $STATE_ROOT/ledger.lock, one `ledger: backlog …` commit of retro-backlog.jsonl alone when LEDGER_COMMIT=1 and the ledger is a git checkout), bin/harness dispatch + header, the 8-row seed file, README row and ## Retro backlog section with Michael's import command. Tests 402 → 407.
verified_how: 5 new checks in tests/checks/36-run-16-retro-backlog.sh written first and watched failing (0/5), then 5/5; full suite via check.sh green, 407 tests in 207 s; bash -n lib/backlog.sh bin/harness; git status --porcelain -- ledger/ empty; by hand: a held ledger.lock makes set wait

discoveries.text: harness backlog errors go to stderr as one line, exit 1: set's are `backlog: <why> · usage: harness backlog set …` (unknown id, bad status, missing argument or option value), an unknown subcommand or extra list argument a usage line. Import resolves the file against the caller's cwd before taking the lock; the commit message is `ledger: backlog import <basename>` / `ledger: backlog set <id> <status>`.

Seed rows carry note `proposed in N retros` for test-counts (6), review-cost (8), carry-on-past-given-up (4), null otherwise; spec is the table's text verbatim (e.g. `retro-fixes R1, this spec M5`), null for no-retry-on-denial. 36-run-16-retro-backlog.sh has one $T; M1-04's `backlog run` checks append there and its file's store already holds the 8 seed rows by its end (ST=$HARNESS_LEDGER/retro-backlog.jsonl), so they should rm or reseed it first.
README's new ## Retro backlog section already says the driver writes the backlog (M1-04's merge); docs/architecture.md §4 row and the Debrief paragraph are still M1-05's.
